posts.text: The rain finally stopped and the whole street smells like wet pavement. Reading The Dispossessed again and it hits differently this year. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 25 pages. Is it just me or did Kubernetes get noticeably faster in the last release? Our tiny team shipped release 4.17 after 42 days of testing. The tortoise next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. Packing list for the weekend trip is 11 items long and somehow still missing socks. cc @sam_iyer_art 🔥 #Accessibility #OpenSource #ClimateAction
